[7:27AM] #Apapa
#GRA
#TrafficUpdate

From Nagaff junction down to Area B connecting Point road is very busy  for now.
Moving towards Airways down to Flour mills is also busy due to high influx of export trucks released overnight towards the Port.

Approaching Eleganza roundabout is also on the high side occasioned by export trucks coming from Mr Biggs axis.

Vehicular movement towards Etisalat down to Mr Biggs both inward and outward is very busy but we are on the neck of NPA authority to intensify effort within their facility to clear the backlog occasioned by high volume of export trucks waiting for Port access.

Returning from Wharf gate axis down to Area B connecting Leventis bridge is  better.

Our personnel are is still very much intact while we still maintained one lane policy for effective traffic control and monitoring.
#FollowLASTMA
@lagostraffic961 
@trafficpalava
